The conference hotel has a discounted room through Tuesday night but no Wednesday availability; a nearby hotel can accommodate all three Philadelphia nights at a higher total. Two Newark-area properties are available Wednesday, one near the supplier site and one with an airport shuttle but a longer morning drive.

events.continuity_hook: Air and the conference stay remain intact, while the new meeting site invalidates Wednesday night's lodging and the planned Thursday ground transfer.
events.interaction_goal: Map a Wednesday Philadelphia-to-Princeton move, compare one-way rental options and hotels near the new facility, confirm Thursday drive and rental-return timing at Newark, cancel the obsolete room within its deadline, and update the final itinerary and trip total.
events.scenario_brief: The supplier moves Thursday's meeting from its Newark-area office to a facility near Princeton and advances the start to 8:00 a.m. Priya's late-afternoon Newark flight remains usable, but the reserved Wednesday hotel is now poorly located and the earlier rail plan no longer reaches the facility in time. Rental cars are available from central Philadelphia with different one-way charges.

events.continuity_hook: The principal vacation arrangements and included resort items remain settled; the schedule adjustment now requires a final check of airport, car-pickup, and resort-arrival timing.
events.interaction_goal: Verify the adjusted flight times, recalculate the arrival-to-rental and rental-to-resort timeline, add the flight details to the car reservation, provide the resort with a realistic arrival window, and compile the confirmed first-day schedule without changing the booked vacation unless a timing conflict appears.
events.scenario_brief: The Kauai vacation is ten days away. The airline has adjusted the outbound departure by 35 minutes without altering the nonstop routing, the resort now asks guests to choose an arrival window, and the rental agency warns that vehicles are released after a stated grace period. Breakfast for two and full-stay parking remain documented on the resort confirmation.

events.continuity_hook: The Kauai vacation has concluded, and a new fixed audit requires an independent air, hotel, and rental-car itinerary.
events.interaction_goal: Compare Tuesday outbound and Friday return options through both airports, calculate complete airfare, three-night lodging, rental-car, fuel, and parking amounts, map realistic drives to the facility, and narrow the trip to a workable routing and refundable hotel shortlist.
events.scenario_brief: Priya is assigned a Wednesday-through-Friday quality audit at a medical-device facility in Carlsbad, California. The opening meeting begins at 8:00 a.m. Wednesday, so she must travel Tuesday, and the closing meeting is expected to finish at 2:30 p.m. Friday. Flights from the Bay Area are available into San Diego and Orange County, but each airport produces a different drive, airfare, and rental-car total. Rooms near the facility are limited during a local event, while properties farther south remain available.

events.continuity_hook: Air and ground transportation are fixed, leaving the three-night hotel as the final major booking for the Carlsbad audit.
events.interaction_goal: Compare complete three-night hotel amounts, verify parking and breakfast charges, map Wednesday-through-Friday commute ranges and the Friday drive to the airport, confirm cancellation deadlines, and reserve the property that gives the audit schedule adequate margin.
events.scenario_brief: The San Diego itinerary is ticketed for Tuesday afternoon through Friday evening, and a rental car is reserved. One Carlsbad hotel is a short drive from the audit site but charges separately for parking and breakfast; another property farther inland has a lower tax-inclusive amount and includes both items, though weekday traffic could lengthen the morning trip. The Friday flight leaves enough time after the scheduled closing meeting if Priya departs the facility promptly.

versions.boundary_condition: Apply only as a general time-of-day preference without inferring a route, date, or leg-specific requirement.
versions.condition: When choosing a flight departure time and no trip-specific timing constraint overrides the preference.
versions.exception_condition: Follow an explicitly stated timing requirement for the current trip; no reusable fallback is established when morning options are unavailable.
versions.name: prefer_morning_flight_departures
versions.scope_condition: Recurring work and leisure flight searches when no meeting, event, or same-day obligation imposes another departure period.

versions.boundary_condition: Do not let price override explicit requirements such as Wi-Fi, acceptable layover length, nonstop service when requested, or required departure and return timing.
versions.condition: When comparing flights that meet the trip's required timing, connectivity, and onboard-feature needs.
versions.default_action: Rank acceptable options by price and choose the cheapest one.
versions.exception_condition: Choose a more expensive option when the cheapest violates a stated must-have or has an unacceptably long or inconvenient layover.
versions.name: Cheapest acceptable flight
versions.preference_value: Prefer the lowest-priced flight that still satisfies essential itinerary and amenity constraints.
versions.scope_condition: Flight decisions after the current trip's timing, routing, cabin, and onboard requirements have established which itineraries are acceptable.

versions.boundary_condition: Do not rank United above other preferred carriers solely from this habit; the evidence only establishes repeated inclusion in multi-carrier sets.
versions.condition: When searching for commercial flights and no current-trip instruction specifies a different carrier set.
versions.default_action: Include United among the preferred carrier options when it is otherwise suitable and comparable.
versions.exception_condition: Use other carriers when United is unavailable, unsuitable for the itinerary, materially worse, or excluded by a current-trip instruction.
versions.name: united_soft_carrier_option
versions.preference_value: United is a recurring acceptable carrier to include among preferred flight options, but is not required or uniquely favored.
versions.scope_condition: Commercial flight searches, especially those originating from her San Francisco home base, when the trip does not specify or exclude particular carriers.

versions.boundary_condition: Treat business class as a soft preference, not a requirement, and do not infer an independent standing budget or price threshold.
versions.default_action: Prefer or surface business-class options first.
versions.exception_condition: Use coach when business class is unavailable, infeasible under explicit current-trip constraints, or declined by the user.
versions.name: prefer_business_class_with_coach_fallback
versions.preference_value: Prefer business class when available and feasible, with coach acceptable as a fallback.
versions.scope_condition: Cabin comparisons for employer-funded audit, supplier, and professional-event travel where an upgraded cabin can reasonably be considered.

versions.boundary_condition: Use a 3.5 minimum when the search is explicitly budget-focused. Apply either threshold only to the rating metric under discussion, and do not conflate hotel class, Google ratings, and customer-review ratings.
versions.condition: When a hotel search calls for a well-rated property and frames the stay as nice, upscale, resort-style, or explicitly budget-focused.
versions.default_action: Filter or prioritize options meeting a 4.0 minimum for nice, upscale, or resort-style searches, and identify the rating source when known.
versions.exception_condition: Follow any newly stated threshold or metric. If no suitable option meets the applicable floor while satisfying more important trip constraints, ask before relaxing it.
versions.name: contextual_hotel_rating_floor
versions.preference_value: Prefer hotels rated at least 4.0 when seeking a nice, upscale, or resort-style stay; for explicitly budget-focused searches, prefer at least 3.5.
versions.scope_condition: Leisure and occasional professional-event hotel searches explicitly framed as nice, upscale, resort-style, or budget-focused.

versions.boundary_condition: Do not infer preferences for other room amenities, hotel types, destinations, dates, or prices.
versions.condition: When searching for or comparing hotel rooms.
versions.default_action: Use both an in-room coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge as soft amenity criteria.
versions.exception_condition: If otherwise suitable options lack either amenity, confirm whether the preference should be relaxed rather than automatically rejecting them.
versions.name: Prefer an in-room coffee maker and mini-fridge
versions.preference_value: Prefer hotel rooms with both a coffee maker and a refrigerator or mini-fridge.
versions.scope_condition: Hotel-room comparisons for multi-night work stays and shared leisure trips when room amenity details are available.

versions.boundary_condition: Treat the pool and exercise facility as the durable core preference and the hot tub as a softer additional preference. Do not infer indoor versus outdoor pool requirements, a specific pool type, or unrelated room amenities unless stated for the current trip.
versions.condition: When choosing or comparing hotels based on wellness or recreation amenities.
versions.default_action: Prioritize hotels that offer both a pool and an on-site fitness center, gym, or comparable exercise facility; among otherwise suitable options, prefer one that also has a hot tub.
versions.exception_condition: Relax the hot-tub preference when it materially limits suitable options, and relax either core amenity when the user explicitly waives it or stronger current-trip constraints favor another hotel.
versions.name: prefers_hotels_with_pool_fitness_and_optional_hot_tub
versions.preference_value: Prefer hotels with both a pool and an on-site fitness facility, with a hot tub as an additional preference when available.
versions.scope_condition: Shared leisure stays where Priya and her spouse expect to exercise or spend downtime at the property.
